summary: Adds scattered points on surfaces, per primitive, inside bounding boxes, approximate volumes, or closed volumes, with rest/deformed input support.
common_gotchas: Volume modes are intended for closed-volume use cases.
Bounding Box mode is faster but less spatially faithful than volume methods.
For deforming geometry, input 0 should be rest geometry and input 1 the deformed surface.
Consolidation can reduce the final output below Number of Points.
key_concepts: Sprinkle SOP creates points on a surface or inside a volume based on the Method menu.
Surface mode distributes by area, while Per Primitive gives each primitive the same point count.
A second input stabilizes scattering on deforming geometry by pairing undeformed input 0 with deformed input 1.
Consolidate removes points until the remaining points meet a minimum distance.
